Warchanter: Warchanters are bards of the battle line. Where other colleges sing in halls, a Warchanter sings in the mud at the front: drums, horns, and chants that keep a warband moving, fearless, and hitting harder. They fight beside the people they inspire, in mail and with a weapon in hand, and their magic is the rhythm a whole army falls into. Play one if you want to stand in the front rank and make everyone around you better: your war chant (Battle Hymn) starts as a bonus action and boosts every ally's weapon damage, and most of your later features grow stronger while it runs. Your spells come from the Bard's schools of magic, as for any Bard; the college adds to them and takes nothing away.
